verdict.rationale: Marqeta is documented as an API-first platform. Its Core API covers card creation, card state transitions, users, businesses, card products, velocity and authorization controls, transactions, disputes, webhooks and sandbox simulations, so most core operations are reachable programmatically. However, no evidence explicitly states parity between the API and any UI or dashboard, and the MCP server exposes only a 'designated set' of endpoints. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, coverage of admin and dashboard functions (e.g., reporting, program configuration) via the API, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use open APIs to create new payment products or streamline supplier and workforce payments.
You create a card using the `user_token` of the user who will own the card and the `card_product_token`
Use the `/cardtransitions` API to set the state of an existing card.
Use the `/cases` endpoint to manage transaction disputes on the Mastercard network.
You can also retrieve transactions associated with specific cards, merchants, and account holders using the endpoints described here.
Use the Marqeta MCP Server with your own AI agents to query data from a designated set of Marqeta's Core API endpoints.
